caseNameFull: Oyler v. Adams, Warden and Crabtree v. Adams, Warden

opinions.text: Certiorari, ante, p. 810, to the Supreme Court of Appeals of West Virginia. It is ordered that David Ginsburg, Esquire, of Washington, District of Columbia, a member of the Bar of this' Court, be, and he is hereby, appointed to serve as counsel for petitioners in these cases.
